entry.title: Potential1200 1.0.2
entry.summary: **Potential1200 1.0.2** - **Fixed: the numbers on the break waveform.** The chop lines could show the wrong pad number (2, 3, 3, 4, 6, 6 ... instead of 1, 2, 3, 4 ...) with no bar under them. The waveform's picture strip was taller than the MPC skin allows, so it was shrunk and the pictures shifted. It is now drawn to fit: every line shows its own pad's number and the hit under it.

entry.title: Potential1200 1.0.1
entry.summary: **Potential1200 1.0.1** - **Every break becomes a 2-bar loop that starts on a kick on the 1**, so it spreads evenly across the 8 pads whatever the file's length. A loop file starts on its own bar line; a long drum take or song gets a random 2 bars that start on a kick on a strong beat (a different part each RANDOM BREAK). A 1-bar loop stays 1 bar. - **Loop tempo from the file's length.** A loop without the tempo in its name gets the tempo that fits its length in whole bars, so MATCH (TUNE) and M

entry.title: Potential1200 1.0.0
entry.summary: **Potential1200 1.0.0**: the first release. That late-80s 12-bit drum sound on your MPC: 8 faders, 8 pads, and every sound sampled at 26 kHz into 12 bits, with drop-sample pitch, the classic filters and the 45 > 33 trick. - **Sounds** from your one-shots (a `DRUM ONE SHOTS` folder, which MPC TOOLS 1.5.9 can make for you) or a break from your `DRUM BREAKS LIBRARY`, chopped across the pads. - **PERFORM** (8 faders), **PROGRAM**, **KIT** and **SETUP** pages, plus the on-screen manual. - **SAVE KIT*
